_comment: FROZEN by KAN-112 comment 10583 (2026-11-12): CLI version, budgets and stopping rules only. Not a paired-trial approval: arm B is unverified.
effort_note: CLI default in both arms (no --effort), recorded per trial

A.route: plain Claude Code in the QB agent container (pilot profile)
A.evidence: the Mac smoke (2026-11-12) verified account and model access only; it is not the benchmark baseline

B.route: QB arm E pipeline in the QB agent container (pilot profile)
B.evidence: sign-in route not approved; QB's stored-credential flow is not used for the pilot

budgets.notes: Arm A: claude -p killed at 1800 s. Arm B: QB total agent time across all attempts capped at 1800 s (agentTimeMs). QB non-agent stages use QB's stage deadlines and are reported separately.

stop_rules.on_auth_failure: stop; INFRA_INTERRUPTION/auth; no retry; never switch account or provider
stop_rules.on_budget_reached: stop; grade the existing patch; none = NO_USABLE_PATCH
stop_rules.on_preflight_failure: refuse to start (version mismatch, credential or billing-override variable); not a trial
stop_rules.reruns: new attempt id, reviewer approval only, original retained

agent.environment: both arms: plain unmodified Claude Code in the same pinned QB agent container (image, repo snapshot, network policy, managed settings, deadline)
